moments.why: It represents the basic unit of a neural network, holding a numeric value between 0 and 1 that indicates how active the neuron is.
They allow the network to perform intermediate, layered abstractions necessary for solving complex recognition tasks.
They determine the strength and influence of connections between neurons in adjacent layers, acting as the primary parameters for pattern recognition.
It squishes any arbitrary real number into a standardized range between 0 and 1, simulating whether a neuron is active or inactive.
It provides a threshold adjustment that dictates how active a neuron must be before it starts significantly contributing to the next layer.
It is the process of automatically tuning thousands of weights and biases to find a configuration that successfully solves the task.
